Name: (CP) Refined Fire Quartz
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hello everyone!
[size=2]once again, instead of working on old mods, that need work, I have decided to make a new mod.
[/size][size=1]just so y'all know, I made this mod because I wanted to, It was bugging me for a long time and I wanted to make it for myself. If you don't like it, you don't have to download it.[/size][size=2]

[/size][size=3]This mod adds in: Refined Fire Quartz, Fire Crystal Path (item), Refined Fire Quartz Sword(you buy it from Marlon's) Fire Crystal Path (recipe(you buy it from Robin's)), Lavender Quartz (you can get it by mining the purple ore nodes in mines levels 41-69.), Refined Lavender Quartz, Refined Lavender Quartz Sword(you also buy it from Marlon's), Lavender Crystal path (item), Lavender Crystal path (Recipe(available to buy at Robin's)), Lime Quartz(you can get it in the mines, the ore node spawns in levels 13-27), Refined Lime Quartz, Lime Crystal Path (Recipe), and Lime Crystal Path(Item).

I think the recipes require Mining level 2.

[/size][size=4]⭐Big thanks to Hayato2236 for creating and maintaining the spanish translation files, and for their kind words!⭐[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[size=5]Requirements: [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions,[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher,[/url] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][size=4]and SMAPI[/size]
[/url]


[size=5]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS: [/size]
[size=4]Extract the .zip files into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]

Please do not upload these files as your own mod.
Or post to any other mod sites.
Or post on sites behind a paywall/sell otherwise.

[size=3]If you guys have any ideas for crafting recipes made with Refined Fire Quartz, I'd be happy to add it! (Within reason, of course)
If y'all want to make recolors for the path, feel free to do so, please just use the .png replace method, and do not include my content .json
[/size][size=2]If there are any bugs, or problems, please let me know, provide a log, and I will do my best to fix them, within a reasonable amount of time.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Added Lime Quartz + Refined Lime Quartz + Refined Lime Quartz Sword + Lime Crystal Path, Made all paths produce 5 paths per 1 refined quartz, changed swords currency to refined quartz, Fixed getting paths when reaching mining level 2 bug.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Refined Fire Quartz
Manifest.Description: Adds in refined fire quartz, you can get it by smelting fire quartz you get from the mines.
Manifest.Author: ritzygen
